explanation: OEIS A100434 conjectures c(n) + d(n) = e(n) + f(n) (with e(2n) = d(2n)/2, e(2n+1) = −d(2n)/2, f(2n) = f(2n+1) = d(2n+1)/2, as in the file). The formal statement is e(n) + f(n) = b(n) with the sign-corrected b, which is equivalent given c + d = b (I checked e + f = b_formal numerically for n < 38). It matches the intended chain of equalities, but it is phrased through the corrected b rather than the OEIS's c + d. Severity 2 (documentation/phrasing deviation only).
